description: Defines a DashboardPage class for UI automation in C# using Selenium WebDriver. It extends a BasePage class and includes a method to verify if the dashboard page is loaded by checking for a specific header element.

classes.name: DashboardPage
classes.description: Represents the Dashboard page in the UI automation framework, providing a method to verify if the page has loaded.

methods.name: IsLoaded
methods.description: Checks whether the dashboard page has been loaded by verifying the presence of the header element.
